A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same survey, with readable text, equations, figures, tables, and end matter. Neither contains an appendix; v4 adds author biographies.

before.justification: v1 compiles results from cited studies in Tables 2–3 and discusses prior findings. Its illustrative token-count calculations do not constitute original empirical results.

after.justification: v4 retains the compilation of cited results in Tables II–III. No original experiments, simulations, user studies, or data analyses are reported.

M1.justification: The work remains a survey with the same modality and mechanism taxonomy. Additional descriptions of cited methods do not introduce or modify an algorithm proposed by this work.

E1.justification: The image and video benchmark columns in the quantitative comparisons remain unchanged. New application references and removal of the benchmark catalogue do not establish added or removed evaluations.

E2.justification: Table III removes VisionZip from the comparison at 50% token retention, although its 25% and 15% rows remain. Other comparison membership is unchanged.

E3.justification: Retained comparisons preserve their token counts or retention ratios, image resolutions, and metrics. Removal of benchmark documentation does not establish a change to experimental procedures.

E4.justification: No ablation, robustness test, or empirical case analysis is added or removed. Existing cited findings about pooling, convolution, and compression tradeoffs are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests for the tabulated results.

E6.justification: v1 Table 3's VisionZip 50% row disappears, including ActivityNet accuracy 45.42 and VideoMME 54.2. All retained numerical table entries match. The applications introduction also replaces the claim of greater than 70% task-agnostic redundancy with 'high' redundancy.

T1.justification: v4 adds an explicit mathematical definition of ToMe's merged token set in Equation 7, where v1 Section 3.2 provided only a verbal description. The remaining equations are retained, and no proofs are added.

C1.justification: Both claim a first systematic survey organized around images, videos, and audio, with four compression mechanisms. The contributions of consolidating methods, identifying challenges, and outlining future directions remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Section VI-C adds a finite-redundancy explanation for why combining compression methods may not help. Section VII-B replaces broad PET-MRI and lossless-compression claims with a concrete TCP-LLaVA pathology example, while removing the caution about preserving micro-lesions.

D1.justification: v4 removes Table 4's complete guide to task types, metrics, and system prompts for 21 benchmarks without replacement, substantially reducing technical reference information. The public repository disclosure remains, moved to a first-page footnote.

R1.justification: v4 adds cited works including MovieChat, DTC, AIM, ToSA, and TCP-LLaVA, and removes benchmark references associated with Table 4. These update literature coverage without substantially changing the survey's research positioning.

P1.justification: The eight-section organization remains intact. Changes include local grammar and terminology corrections, a rewritten medical-applications paragraph, renumbered headings, and added author biographies.

P2.justification: v4 reformats the document throughout, including a single-column abstract, changed typography and heading styles, denser references, and author portraits. Figure 3 gains entries, Table 4 is removed, and quantitative table captions and row arrangements are revised.

improvement.justification: v4 adds useful references, a ToMe formalization, and a concrete pathology example. However, removing the benchmark guide and the video table's provenance and metric-abbreviation explanations reduces the survey's practical reference value and makes its comparisons less self-contained. These losses outweigh the limited refinements, while the core survey remains intact.
